title: Learning to quantify uncertainty in off-target activity for CRISPR guide RNAs
relevance_to_cellguide: Trained on CHANGE-seq data from the SAME 110 sgRNAs / 13 therapeutically relevant loci in human primary T cells used elsewhere in this literature set. Produces crispAI-aggregate, a genome-wide off-target specificity score with calibrated uncertainty — directly usable as the 'specificity' + 'uncertainty' terms in the plan's §4.4 scoring formula and §4.3 uncertainty evaluation metric.
